connector.name: Real Fake Data
connector.registryDescription: Realistic synthetic test data - valid PESELs, NIPs, IBANs, addresses, people across 27 EU countries.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package real-fake-data-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the przeslijmi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: REAL_FAKE_DATA_API_KEY
env.description: API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, lifting requests onto your metered plan. Omit to use the anonymous lane.

env.name: REAL_FAKE_DATA_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the hosted API. Defaults to https://api.real-fake-data.com; point it at a local API during development.
